name: arm-vm
label: arm-vm
machine_label: a current Arm server core in a cloud VM, 16 vCPU (16 cores, no SMT), spot, PMU on

micro.invol_bound_record: rule of 2026-11-18: per thread max(5, 25/s x window), times the threads, on every box (5 per thread at the 0.2 s smoke, 25 per thread at 1 s)

note: The Arm VM (16 vCPU, one per core, no SMT): perf through sudo; the harness is not pinned (no core left); steal time gated at 2%. Microbenchmarks: one thread per core on CPUs 0-15, threads 1, 4, 8 and 12 (8 for the curve; top: 15 saturated the VM, the shared cases failed the overlap gate), histogram workers 1 and 12; the involuntary-switch bound is frozen from the session's smoke. Binaries in <root>/<commit>/<target>, pinned by sha256 in boxes/sha256/arm-vm.txt after the rebuild. The origin image digest and the end-to-end binary paths are set on the VM at its step 0.

aarch64.source: the main dev image at 5e1439980a (its /usr/local/bin/envoy; inline LL/SC atomics)

codegen.note: r* and connections per worker as run U on the bench box; the smoke's client headroom, rate and overlap gates decide 12w against the 8w fallback (same client and origin cores, CPUs 8-11 then idle)

micro_lse.invol_bound_record: rule of 2026-11-18: per thread max(5, 25/s x window), times the threads, on every box (5 per thread at the 0.2 s smoke, 25 per thread at 1 s)
micro_lse.note: the same benchmark source (964d72f7a6, the fix arm with time-based batching) built twice: forced inline LSE and forced load/store-exclusive (no outline helpers); pins from boxes/sha256/arm-vm-lse.txt (the build record, <sha256>  <dir>/<target>); every benchmark's label must say atomics=lse (fix-lse) or atomics=base (fix-llsc)
